title: Container
description: A container the engine runs (or has stopped), as its inspect output says.

project.description: the compose project, from its label

service.description: the compose service, from its label

image.description: the image reference it was started from

health.description: its health check's status, if it has one

read_only.description: whether its root filesystem is read-only

ports.description: published ports: container port, host address and port

mounts.description: binds and volumes: type, name, source, destination, rw

networks.description: each network and the aliases it answers to there

env_names.description: the names of its environment settings (never values)

dials.description: where its URL-valued settings point: the setting's name, scheme, host and port only
